hazard_classes.stream.gap.warmup: no readings while a new sensor warms up
hazard_classes.stream.gap.signal_loss: readings missing after an outage longer than the sensor can backfill
hazard_classes.stream.gap.not_scanned: history lost because a scan-based sensor was not scanned within its memory
hazard_classes.stream.backfilled: an outage the receiver recovered: readings present, arrived late
hazard_classes.stream.compression_low: a false low while the wearer lay on the sensor
hazard_classes.stream.sensor_failed: a sensor that ended before its wear period
hazard_classes.stream.scan_duplicate: a scan reading next to the historic reading of the same minutes
hazard_classes.stream.out_of_range_text: a reading printed as a word (Low/High, LO/HI) instead of a number
hazard_classes.stream.out_of_range_sentinel: a reading coded as a number outside the range (39, 401) with a status
hazard_classes.stream.out_of_range_clamped: a reading past the range written as the range limit, indistinguishable from it
hazard_classes.stream.unsorted_rows: rows grouped by device and record type, not in time order
hazard_classes.stream.locale_date_order: day-first dates that parse as month-first when the day is 12 or less
hazard_classes.stream.metadata_in_header: institution, patient and device written into header cells after the column names
hazard_classes.stream.extension_mismatch: a file named .xls whose bytes are an OOXML workbook
hazard_classes.stream.unit_healthkit_mmol: HealthKit's mmol unit string with the molar mass inside it
hazard_classes.stream.no_export: the app shows the readings but hands over only reports and screenshots
hazard_classes.stream.sectioned_csv: one file holding several tables, each under its own separator and header
hazard_classes.stream.blocks_not_interleaved: readings, calibrations and treatments in separate blocks, each in time order
hazard_classes.stream.window_24h: a follower feed holding only the last 24 hours
hazard_classes.stream.window_12h: a follower feed holding only the last 12 hours
hazard_classes.stream.unrounded_conversion: mg/dL recomputed from stored mmol/L without rounding (99.9976941658)
hazard_classes.stream.report_only: the readings reach the wearer only as a summary report
hazard_classes.stream.chart_values: curves and bars a reader must not mistake for, or read as, individual readings
hazard_classes.stream.local_time_no_offset: wall-clock timestamps with no UTC offset
hazard_classes.stream.utc_and_local_pair: each record carries UTC and local time; they must not be double-shifted
hazard_classes.stream.utc_only: UTC timestamps; the local day must be reconstructed
hazard_classes.stream.unit_mmol: glucose in mmol/L where the catalogue unit is mg/dL
hazard_classes.stream.bom: a byte order mark before the first header
hazard_classes.stream.store_delay: the app writes to the phone store hours after the reading
hazard_classes.stream.off_wrist: a span with no samples because the device was off the body
hazard_classes.stream.workout_burst: sampling jumps from minutes to seconds during a workout
